violation_type.title: Child Becomes Ill in Care and Requires Immediate Treatment or Hospitalization - Contact Parent (26 TAC §746.3605(b)(3))
violation_type.short_title: Child Becomes Ill in Care and Requires Immediate Treatment or Hospitalization - Contact Parent
violation_type.typical_finding: The daycare failed to notify the parent immediately after a child in care experienced a medical emergency that required medical treatment and subsequently hospitalization.

finding_variants.text: The daycare failed to notify the parent immediately after a child in care experienced a medical emergency that required medical treatment and subsequently hospitalization.
